questions.prompt: Which project type has no entry point (`Main` method), outputs a `.dll`, and is meant to be referenced by other projects?
questions.explanation: A Class Library builds reusable components or business logic, outputs a `.dll`, has no `Main` entry point and can be referenced by other projects or shipped as a NuGet package.

questions.prompt: What output type does an ASP.NET web application produce, according to the note?
options: A `.dll` hosted on IIS or Kestrel
questions.explanation: The ASP.NET Web Application section lists its output type as `.dll`, hosted on IIS or Kestrel.

questions.prompt: How do the two Blazor types differ?
options: Blazor Server runs in the browser; Blazor WebAssembly runs on the server
Blazor Server runs on the server and uses SignalR; Blazor WebAssembly runs in the browser
Blazor Server is for desktop apps; Blazor WebAssembly is for mobile apps
Blazor Server uses JavaScript components; Blazor WebAssembly uses Razor components
questions.explanation: The note lists Blazor Server as running on the server and using SignalR, and Blazor WebAssembly as running in the browser; both use Razor components written in C#.

questions.prompt: You need a background service that processes a message queue on a schedule. Which project type fits?
questions.explanation: A Worker Service is for background services or daemons, such as scheduled tasks and message queue processors, and uses the hosted service model.

questions.prompt: Which project type builds cross-platform apps for Android, iOS, Windows and macOS from a shared codebase?
questions.explanation: A .NET MAUI App targets Android, iOS, Windows and macOS with a shared codebase, using XAML UI and MVVM.
